scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to 0<lambda<1, b=d=0 and the sign sector y0>=0,c*x0>0, with a reflected sign-sector corollary. Existence but not uniqueness of critical initial speeds is shown; remaining initial-state sectors, nonlinear attractors and uniform parameter endpoints are not classified.
title: A parabolic escape separator and a sign-changing logarithmic drift in a rational plane map
